lines.text: Eliphaz the Temanite asks whether a wise man would fill his belly with the hot east wind.
Eliphaz says Job's own mouth condemns him and asks if Job was the first man ever born, before the hills.
Eliphaz says the gray-haired and the aged are on his side, men much older than Job's father.
Eliphaz says the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, is marked for the sword, and wanders as food for eagles.
Eliphaz says the wicked man stretches his hand against God, rushes at Him with a thick shield, and will dwell in holy cities.
